_description: SS with custom haircut percentage (30%). Tests haircut activation at 2034 and custom percentage.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, $30k SS at age 62, custom 30% haircut. Pre-2034 (ages 62-67): full $30k/yr. From 2034 (age 68+): $30k * 0.70 = $21k/yr. Provisional income always below $25k threshold, so 0% taxable. No spending, no growth.
name: SS Haircut
